title: Explicit AI-chat creation: form checkbox, one-click tile, assistant empty-state
intent: The AI-assistant loop is fully wired on the backend (POST /chats {title, is_ai}, auto bot runs on messages in is_ai chats, /assistant over is_ai chats) but the frontend has NO way to create an is_ai chat: the create form carries only title, the port contract has no is_ai field, so every user chat is is_ai=false and /assistant is permanently empty. Three additive entries close the gap: (A) an 'AI-ассистент' checkbox in the chat-create form flowing title+is_ai through controller/port/adapter to POST /chats; (B) a one-click 'Чат с AI' tile next to the create form that creates an is_ai chat with a default title in a single action; (C) an /assistant empty-state that offers 'Создать чат с ассистентом' when the user has no is_ai chats. No backend changes — ChatCreate.is_ai already exists and bot runs are already auto-triggered by controller.sendMessage for is_ai chats.

requirements.title: Port/adapter/controller carry is_ai through chat creation
requirements.description: ChatsPort.createChat widens additively via CreateChatData in src/utils/types.ts gaining is_ai?: boolean; the own adapter sends is_ai in the POST /chats payload when set (backend defaults is_ai=false); ChatsController.create(data: {title; is_ai?}) forwards it to port.createChat; existing title-only call sites (chat.ts:394) and test literals stay valid; toChatInfo already maps is_ai and the card renders the ✦AI badge.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-10-27 (no explicit way to create an AI chat)

requirements.title: AI checkbox in the chat-create form (entry A)
requirements.description: ChatListCreate renders an 'AI-ассистент' checkbox as a SIBLING of the embedded {{{ Form }}} inside the component's <li> (the Form's inner markup is fixed by form.hbs — no slot; review F2); the page's handleSubmitClick reads it at submit time via this.refs.create (the existing precedent) -> .querySelector('input[name=is_ai]')?.checked — value serialization never reaches the page (Form passes only the serialized title). Unchecked behaves exactly as today; emptyValidator applies to the title input only.

requirements.title: One-click 'Чат с AI' tile next to the create form (entry B)
requirements.description: A compact 'Чат с AI' Button rendered inside ChatListCreate's <li> next to the Form (review F5): type='button' (not a submit), callback prop onAiChatClick from the page -> ChatsController.create({title: AI_CHAT_TITLE, is_ai: true}) — one click, no modal; the created chat appears with the ✦AI badge and is selectable like any chat; existing styles, no new design tokens; AI_CHAT_TITLE lives in src/utils/constants.ts (shared lower layer — review F4).

requirements.title: /assistant empty-state with a create action (entry C)
requirements.description: The assistant page renders an explicit empty state when the user has no is_ai chats: a short Russian hint plus a 'Создать чат с ассистентом' button. Guard-clean route (review F1): the ai-assistant feature widens its OWN port — AiAssistantPort.createChat({title; is_ai?}) implemented in its own adapter (which already talks to /chats via fetchChats) — and AiAssistantController.createAiChat({title: AI_CHAT_TITLE, is_ai: true}) refreshes the list via the existing loadChats(); the assistant page NEVER imports from features/chats (cross-feature runtime import is a guard blocker). With existing is_ai chats the page renders as today.

requirements.title: Docs closure
requirements.description: docs/NEXT.md records the feature (AI-chat creation entries shipped); docs/progress/progress_log.md gets an entry on top in house style.

constraints: Layers downward only; components never import features/controllers (callbacks come from the page); guard-architecture --all --strict stays green.
No backend changes: ChatCreate.is_ai and the bot auto-trigger already exist; the plan only opens the frontend path to them.
Port widening is additive ({title; is_ai?}) — existing create call sites and test literals stay valid.
UI text in Russian, consistent with the existing messenger UI; no new design tokens (reuse existing button/form styles).
Existing suites stay green; test counts grow from the 378 mocha baseline.
nonGoals: renaming or configuring AI chats after creation (title editing)
multiple assistant personas/models, per-chat model selection
backend seeding of an AI chat for new users (explicit user action only)
changing the bot trigger (already auto on sendMessage in is_ai chats)
the assistant page document flow (already shipped)
